mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which tends to boost equity markets by reducing borrowing costs and increasing liquidity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate signals economic weakness, which can lead to negative S&P 500 returns as investor sentiment deteriorates and corporate earnings expectations decline over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 30% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) is strong but unemployment (UNRATE) is rising, it may indicate labor market tightness and potential inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by 50k and UNRATE rises by 0.2pp
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS and UNRATE meet the trigger, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rates during a tightening cycle increase borrowing costs and reduce liquidity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS increases by 0.25%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth indicates strong economic activity, which tends to boost corporate earnings and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production suggests supply chain issues or reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 30% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When both real estate investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) increase, it indicates strong demand in the housing market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by $10B and HOUST increases by 50k units
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST meet the trigger, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate during an economic expansion indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 30% of periods when UNRATE is below 5%, the hypothesis is rejected.
